title.purpose: Card-level headings, modal titles, empty-state titles.

body.purpose: Default text size for labels, descriptions, table cells.

label.purpose: Error messages, secondary metadata, tiny badge text.

shadows.name: form
shadows.purpose: Lightest lift for buttons and inputs.

shadows.name: profile
shadows.purpose: Deeper shadow for an element floating over another, e.g. the profile avatar over its banner.

shadows.name: creditCard
shadows.purpose: The bank card and mobile top bar; slightly offset rather than purely ambient.

motion.name: auth-illustration-float
motion.purpose: The one deliberate ambient motion moment, on the auth illustration only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The brand CTA: bank-gradient fill, white text, used for the single most important action on a form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0179FE 0%, #4893FF 100%); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #0179FE; box-shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(16,24,40,0.05); transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0179FE; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: De-emphasized action next to a primary one, e.g. 'View all'.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #344054; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #D0D5DD; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FCFCFD; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0179FE; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard flat white card on the gray-25 page ground.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(16,24,40,0.10), 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(16,24,40,0.06); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: #475467; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-amount { font-size: 24px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 600; color: #101828; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field: white fill, gray border, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: #344054; } .ds-input { font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; color: #101828; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D0D5DD; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #667085; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0179FE; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #0179FE; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Semantic category badge drawn from the success/pink/blue tint families — never an arbitrary color.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #D1E9FF; background: #F5FAFF; color: #194185; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px 2px 6px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: The one place a list item gets a filled bank-gradient background: the active nav state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #344054; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0179FE 0%, #4893FF 100%); color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Stat Row Icon Badge
components.description: Small circular tinted icon badge leading a stat-card label, borrowed from dashboard-template conventions and rendered in Horizon's own palette.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-stat-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F5FAFF; color: #175CD3; font-size: 14px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #667085; margin: 0; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #101828; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Horizon reads as a well-kept bank statement, not a flashy fintech pitch deck: white cards, one confident blue, generous whitespace, numbers that are never crowded. That's the resting state of every summary screen — home, balances, profile. But the same system has to work as a precise instrument when a user leans in to check something specific: transaction lists, category breakdowns, budgets. There density is allowed to rise — tighter row rhythm, more numbers on screen — without ever reaching for a different visual language. One palette, one type family, one radius system; only density and information scale with the task. The system is deliberately quiet about itself: no gradients-as-decoration, no icon-tile soup, no drop shadows pretending to be depth. The one place it allows itself a signature move is the brand-blue gradient, reserved for the bank card, the active sidebar state, and primary CTAs — everywhere else stays flat white and neutral gray.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, high-trust, numbers-first — never loud or startup-y
One primary accent (bank blue) used sparingly and consistently
Flat surfaces with soft ambient shadows, never hard drop shadows or heavy borders
Density flexes by task: airy on summary screens, tighter on data-dense ones
Semantic color (success green, alert red/pink) is reserved for meaning, never decoration

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Bank Blue is the only color allowed to carry a primary call-to-action or an active/selected state. A second primary-looking button on the same screen is a bug, not a design choice.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Success green, alert red, and the category palette only appear when they encode a real state or category — never as generic decoration.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Every new screen uses Switzer exclusively; hierarchy comes from the existing weight/size scale, not a new face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a shadow just to look important. Shadow is reserved for the four named roles (form, chart, profile, creditCard); a new component either reuses one of them or stays flat with a hairline border.

dos: Do keep every new card flat on gray-25 with a shadow-chart-equivalent elevation, not a border.
Do reuse the existing text-10 through text-36 scale instead of raw Tailwind text sizes.
Do use Bank Blue for exactly one primary action per screen; everything else is neutral, outline, or ghost.
Do draw any new category/status color from the existing success/pink/blue semantic families.
Do keep multi-currency amounts visually distinct per currency, never summed or blended.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glassmorphism, or heavy borders as a substitute for the flat-plus-soft-shadow elevation model.
Don't use the bank-gradient surface anywhere but the bank card, the active sidebar item, and primary CTA buttons.
Don't invent a new radius value outside the 8/10/12/18px scale (plus full-round for chips, avatars, stat badges, and the active nav item).
Don't imply live, automatic account sync in copy or iconography — linking is manual today.
